title: Invisible Item Frames (Craftable)
description: A simple, vanilla friendly mod that adds craftable invisible item frames while keeping the normal item frame unchanged.
body:
# Invisible Item Frames

> A simple, vanilla friendly mod that adds a craftable Invisible Item Frame while keeping the normal Item Frame unchanged.

## Features

- Adds a **craftable Invisible Item Frame**
- Frame becomes **invisible when placed**
- Displayed items remain **fully visible**
- Works like a normal Item Frame for placing and showing items
- Keeps the **normal Item Frame recipe** available

## Crafting

- Crafted using **1 Item Frame in the center**
- **4 Glass blocks** placed on the **top, bottom, left, and right**

![crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30cfd73b775f84aaca2c2508f62e0a2c53b4d80d.png)

## Version Support Disclaimer

- I will **NOT be adding support for versions below 1.21.11** unless I am actively playing on that version.
- If I update to **newer Minecraft versions**, I may update the mod accordingly.
- **Do not expect updates immediately when a new Minecraft version releases.**

# Message From Creator:

This is a small mod I made because I wanted **both options** normal visible Item Frames and invisible ones. Sometimes you want the frame to show, and sometimes you just want the item itself visible without the frame getting in the way. So instead of replacing the normal Item Frame, this mod adds a separate craftable invisible version.
